title: Storytime
seo_title: Storytime at Lebanon-Laclede County Library, Nov 18
description: Storytime is a kids' program where children sing songs, hear a few books read aloud, make a craft and have a snack. It is typically geared toward 2-6 year olds, and Wednesday and Thursday sessions cover the same material with a different theme each week. It takes place Wednesday, November 18, 2026, from 10:00 to 11:00 AM at Lebanon-Laclede County Library, 915 South Jefferson Ave in Lebanon, MO.
